title: Beta Polarization of Higher Spectral Defects

status_key.proved: Ordinary analytic/algebraic proof is included; no proof-assistant or independent peer-review certification is asserted.

claims.label: hsd:thm:beta
claims.title: Endpoint-subtracted beta master
claims.statement: Holomorphic ordinary integral giving the complete two-linear-factor defect germ.
claims.domain: a>0; polynomial W; Re(a+u), Re(a+v)>0; spectral germ at zero.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Derived here from the classical Euler beta identity.

claims.label: hsd:thm:beta-jets
claims.title: Every defect as lower-order Hurwitz-jet integrals
claims.statement: The r-th defect is a finite sum of ordinary logarithmic beta integrals of jets of order at most r-1.
claims.domain: Same branch domain as Theorem 2.2; integer r>=1.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Representation component of predecessor Section 7.6 Question 2.

claims.label: hsd:thm:stieltjes
claims.title: Global harmonic-Stieltjes coefficient formula
claims.statement: Finite-head normally convergent formula for every defect, including all resonant Laurent contributions.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Independent derivation; the resonant coefficient d[k,r+1] is retained.

claims.label: hsd:thm:gamma-second
claims.title: Exact second defect
claims.statement: Gamma-Hurwitz chord minus a finite odd-weight harmonic polynomial.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Resolves explicit nonlocal/local separation in predecessor Question 2.

claims.label: hsd:thm:nonvanishing
claims.title: Universal second-order vanishing criterion
claims.statement: For each fixed a>0, vanishing for every positive mass is equivalent to W=0.
claims.domain: Fixed a>0; polynomial W, including complex coefficients.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Distinct from the inherited even-polynomial first-order vanishing criterion.

claims.label: hsd:prop:ordinaryK
claims.title: Ordinary logarithm-square Gamma polarization
claims.statement: The unweighted Gamma chord equals an absolutely convergent complex logarithm-square series.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Derived ordinary identity; global historical priority is not asserted.

claims.label: hsd:thm:negative-second
claims.title: Every negative-point second spectral jet
claims.statement: Finite shifted Hurwitz second derivatives and one ordinary integral with finite polylogarithmic integrand.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Partial answer to predecessor Question 1: explicit integrand, not minimum function algebra.

claims.label: hsd:thm:Appell
claims.title: All-order normalized mass primitives
claims.statement: Harmonic normalization yields an Appell-type mass ladder with all zero-mass boundary values explicit.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: The unnormalized second jet has an inhomogeneous ladder.

claims.label: hsd:thm:masses
claims.title: Any number of quadratic masses
claims.statement: Second spectral derivative decomposes into single-mass jets and pairwise ordinary mass covariances.
claims.domain: a>0; even polynomial W; positive masses, including repeats; also bilateral 0<a<1.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Resolves two-mass representation in predecessor Question 7 and extends it to any number of factors.

claims.label: hsd:thm:collision
claims.title: Complete coincident-mass expansion
claims.statement: Every confluent coefficient is a harmonic multiple of a finite polygamma-Bernoulli resolvent.
claims.domain: |h|<a^2+b^2 in squared-mass continuation; bilateral radius min(a,1-a)^2+b^2.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Resolves the confluent component of predecessor Question 7.

claims.label: hsd:thm:shiftprimitive
claims.title: Every anchored shift primitive
claims.statement: All repeated shift primitives reduce to finite Hurwitz jets and ordinary beta integrals with fixed constants.
claims.domain: Positive real anchor and shift, or their branch-safe analytic continuation; positive integer primitive order.
claims.relation_to_prior_work: Exact primitives, not primitives with unspecified polynomial constants.
